nodes.title: Way faster than default VAE
widgets_values:
## Workstation full-precision video VAE

This adapted graph uses the checksum-pinned full-precision video VAE (`minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors`) installed by the local downloader. The upstream Kijai int8-convrot VAE is not used on this workstation: the RTX 6000 Pro Blackwell cards run the full-precision VAE as the quality baseline. Keep it unless re-tuning the graph for a small-VRAM box.

# Low-noise LoRAs: High effect on details
### Anything that has to do with details should go here. It will have minimal impact on motion as that was taken care of by the first stage. You can definitely repeat some LoRAs between stages.

# High Noise LoRAs: High effect on motion and composition
### This isn't like Wan high noise low noise, it just means things like realism loras are useless here. Things like motion loras (camera movement, action) should definitely go here. This also effects the audio massively as we do not resample the audio.

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a narrow, rain-slicked New York alleyway at night under flickering neon spill from a side street. Two muscular men face each other in the center: Fighter A, a stocky Caucasian man in a torn dark hoodie and jeans, fists raised; Fighter B, a taller Black man in a bloodied white tank top and cargo pants. Wet brick walls, overflowing trash cans, and fire escapes line both sides. Distant city traffic glows at the alley mouth. Fighter A lunges forward with a powerful right hook; Fighter B slips the punch and counters with a sharp jab to the ribs. The camera holds a slight push-in with small amplitude as rain continues to fall.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.800, the camera cuts to a tight medium shot of Fighter B’s face as he absorbs a heavy left hook from Fighter A, head snapping sideways, sweat and rain spraying. The camera shakes strongly with the impact.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.200, the shot cuts to a dynamic tracking shot following Fighter A as he drives Fighter B backward into a row of metal trash cans. The cans crash and scatter. Fighter A unleashes a rapid flurry of body punches; Fighter B blocks some and returns a vicious uppercut that lifts Fighter A’s chin. The camera trucks right with large amplitude at fast speed, staying locked on the exchange.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, the camera cuts to a low-angle medium-close shot of Fighter B slamming Fighter A against the wet brick wall. Fighter A’s head rebounds off the wall. Fighter B follows with a short right cross to the jaw. The camera tilts up slightly with small amplitude as Fighter A’s knees buckle.
[Shot 5] At 00:09.800, the shot switches to a handheld medium-wide shot as Fighter A suddenly surges forward, tackling Fighter B to the rain-soaked pavement. They grapple and roll, fists still flying. Fighter A ends up on top and rains down punches. The camera shakes strongly and tracks the rolling motion at fast speed.
[Shot 6] At 00:12.600, the camera cuts to a tight close-up of Fighter B’s bloodied face as he catches Fighter A’s wrist mid-punch, then headbutts him hard. Blood spatters. The camera holds static for a beat, then pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed on Fighter B’s determined eyes as he shoves Fighter A off and scrambles back to his feet.
[Shot 7] At 00:15.000, the shot transitions to a medium tracking shot circling both men as they stand and trade final heavy blows—Fighter A lands a crushing overhand right, Fighter B answers with a spinning elbow. Both stagger but stay upright, fists still raised under the falling rain and neon glow. The camera arcs slowly around them with medium amplitude.


overall_soundscape: Heavy rain drums constantly on pavement, metal cans, and brick. Sharp flesh-on-flesh impacts, bone-jarring punches, and metallic crashes of trash cans echo off the alley walls. Grunts, strained breathing, and wet scuffling footsteps mix with distant muffled city traffic and occasional car horns.


non_diegetic_music: Driving low-end electronic pulses and aggressive industrial percussion at a fast tempo, layered with distorted bass stabs that intensify during impacts and drop briefly into sparse tension before surging again.
